description: 2015 Nepal Earthquake Data Archive: Nyatapola Temple is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Richard L Wood, University of Nebraska Lincoln (unl.edu). Digital archive of the field collected data and the generated numerical models of the Nyatapola Temple in Bhaktapur, Nepal. Field collected data includes the ambient vibrations, photos, and lidar from June 2015. The numerical models include a finite element model developed in SAP2000 and an applied element model developed in Extreme Loading on Structures (ELS). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2DT3B. Keywords: 2015 Nepal Earthquake, Masonry Temple, Lidar, Damage Characterization, Modeling. Published 2019-01-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
